registered: 2026-11-02 before candidate fitting or new candidate profit evaluation
hypothesis: Predicting expected value over four complete holding windows may find more robust exits than a fixed ten-bar action-value student.
features: Frozen 18 causal opportunity features; no teacher outcome or future prices as input
teacher: After the signal, compute gross one-MNQ-contract outcomes for long and short at horizons 3, 5, 10 and 20, under immediate and one-bar-delayed next-open entry. Hindsight best action is diagnostic only. Train expected action values for all opportunities, including losers and abstentions.
decision: For each horizon and direction, require positive expected net after $6 stress cost for both immediate and one-bar-delayed entries. Choose the action with largest minimum expected net; ties use shorter horizon then long before short. Otherwise abstain.
execution: Causal next-open fill; fixed chosen holding horizon in 3,5,10,20; base/stress/extreme costs; evaluate immediate and one-bar-delayed signals. Compare unchanged $8 gate on identical windows.
risk: Report bar-close and trade-level drawdowns; user specified no maximum, so risk-limit qualification remains open
selection: No policy promotion from already inspected windows; no threshold or horizon tuning after results
confirmation: Requires later untouched, source-audited observations after a complete freeze
